_about: 2016-census side (c1) of the people-interpolation store for the 2013 federal election. The /map/ census-people lanes interpolate between bracketing censuses to election day on the SEIFA pcti lanes' day-share of the intercensal span (the f factor lives in data/booth-demo-2013.json's demoInterp record, written by the interp blend pass); this store is the far side ONLY — the measured side is the 2011-census venue store (data/booth-demo-2013.json). A booth's demo block is the 2016 Census General Community Profile counts of the 2016-census SA1 its premises coordinates (data/booth-seifa-2013.json) fall in, point-in-polygon against the ABS 1270.0.55.001 July 2016 SA1 shapes — the venue's neighbourhood, never the booth's voters. A division's row is the 2016 GCP whole-allocated to CED_2011 and summed, membership by CG-plurality (CG_SA1_2011_SA1_2016 ratios x the source SA1's 2011 BCP headcount) onto the measured store's own 1270055003_ced_2011 allocation map, so both sides divide on the identical boundary set. Shares mirror the voter/venue lanes: age renormalised over the 11 G01 bands; language other-at-home over English-only + other; overseas-born over country-of-birth stated; university (bachelor and above) per the aged-15+ population less level-of-education-not-stated; the new lane set mirrors the voter stores (G01's highest-year-of-schooling persons columns — year-12-or-less over the six printed stated levels; G07's Tot-row Indigenous/Indigenous-plus-non-Indigenous share; G14's Religion menu ten shares (rel, key order in relKeys) over the ex-affiliation-not-stated basis; G33's Housing-tenure menu four shares (ten, key order in tenKeys, owned-with-mortgage leading) over the ex-tenure-not-stated occupied-private-dwellings basis; G05's Marital status menu five shares (mar, key order in marKeys, married leading) of people aged 15+ over their own printed-category sum; G28's one-parent share of families; the under-15 share of the stated ages); blue-collar over the eight stated ANZSCO groups; G51's industry-of-employment nineteen ANZSIC-2006 divisions (ind, key order in indKeys) each shared over the divisions' stated sum. Income lanes are the voter store's algorithm on the 2016 GCP's G28/G29 (16-band grid, FI/HI stems): household masses re-weighted to adults at data/income-dist.json's factors; loinc the adult share below the 2016 national 25th-percentile cut (incomeCuts.loCutWeekly, in 2016 dollars), hiinc the $4,000-top-band share, incMed the band-interpolated median weekly household income in 2016 dollars on the household basis (its national value pinned beside the ABS-published $1,438). A booth whose premises sit outside every 2016 SA1 polygon, or whose lat/lon are absent/(0,0), carries demo:null (counts.boothsPipMiss), as does one whose SA1 housed no one (boothsPipEmpty); inside a present block a lane is nulled rather than clamped when GCP perturbation would put its share outside [0,1].
